analyzed_vuln.description: The fuzzer SAPI manually releases EG(exception) via zend_object_release() before normal request shutdown. In this PoV, EG(exception) points to an exception object that is still reachable from userland structures (through generator/object property cycles). The manual release frees the exception object early, but later php_request_shutdown()->shutdown_destructors() iterates the symbol table and calls zval_call_destructor(), which reads the refcount of the same zval/object, causing a heap-use-after-free in zend_gc_refcount().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a thrown exception object to remain referenced in user variables/cyclic structures while also being stored in EG(exception). The PoV does this using generator send()/catch behavior and cyclic references, so fuzzer_request_shutdown() first decrements/frees EG(exception), then standard shutdown still processes remaining references during symbol-table/object destruction, leading to UAF read of freed zend_object memory.
